title: Chapter alternatives · what-if drafts
help: Explore other directions for this chapter. Only the main manuscript participates in default text, word totals and book exports. Alternatives stay in project history and do not alter Canon, State or the timeline.
differentPath: Versions use the main manuscript selected by the book catalog, rather than the other revision currently open. Review the file path first.
canonicalChanged: The catalog now prefers another manuscript. Existing versions remain associated with their original file. Only a review candidate can be retained; no canonical switch will be claimed.
protectedMain: Final or committed manuscripts are protected. The alternative can only be retained as a review candidate in history. It creates no chapter manuscript and does not switch the official main line; adoption still requires the existing revision review.
new: Copy main line to an alternative
empty: No alternatives yet. Copy the main line when you want to explore another direction.
name: Version name
mainEditorNotice: The main manuscript is read-only here. Edit its text in the original editor; only its version name and description can be changed here.
unsavedAlternative: This alternative has not been saved. The main manuscript and official setting remain unchanged.
alternativeNotice: This is a separate alternative. Editing or saving it does not alter the main manuscript or setting.
diffLabel: Left: the main manuscript as loaded. Right: the current alternative edit. Comparing does not save any text.
revision: Keep as review candidate (keep official main line)
unsavedNotice: This version has unsaved changes. Save them, or explicitly discard them before switching or leaving.
limits: Up to {{count}} versions per chapter, including archived versions. Each text uses the existing 2 MiB editor limit; combined version data is limited to 24 MiB. Archiving retains recoverable content.
undoHelp: Undo validates text and version metadata. Later manuscript edits, new versions or metadata changes are not overwritten; compare history instead. Withdrawing a review candidate updates the record only and does not delete the alternative.
historyUnavailable: The version operation was handled, but history is temporarily unavailable. Keep the current receipt and reload later; do not repeat a completed operation.
refreshAfterSuccess: A real save receipt was received, but the view could not be refreshed. Reload later; do not repeat a completed operation.
revisionResult: A fixed review candidate was retained in project history. No chapter file was created and the official main line was not switched. View the frozen diff; actual adoption requires the existing revision review, without directly committing Canon, State or Knowledge.
replayed: This is the existing receipt for the same operation. No duplicate save or copy was made.
discard: This version has unsaved input. Explicitly discard it and continue with the requested action?
archiveConfirm: Archive “{{name}}”? Its content remains recoverable in project history. The main manuscript will not be deleted.
restoreConfirm: Restore “{{name}}” from the archive as an editable alternative?
revisionConfirm: Retain “{{name}}” as a review candidate? It stays in project history, creates no chapter file, and does not change default text, statistics, search or book exports.
switchConfirm: Replace the current main manuscript with the saved text of “{{name}}”? The old main manuscript will remain as another version, with an undoable receipt. No story facts will be committed.
fixedRequest: This action uses the loaded version and fixed revision checks. Any manuscript or metadata changes stop it. Cancel sends no write request.
undoConfirm: Undo this main-line switch? It runs only while text and version metadata still match the receipt. A pre-undo history snapshot is retained.
selectChapter: Open a manuscript chapter before managing its alternatives.

result.APPLIED: The main manuscript was switched. Its prior text and switch receipt were retained.
result.PREPARED: The operation has no complete save receipt yet. Review history.
result.ROLLED_BACK: The save did not complete; the previous state was safely restored.
result.RECOVERY_REQUIRED: Later changes were detected and left untouched. Review text and history.
result.REVIEW_CANDIDATE: Review candidate retained; no official main-line switch or chapter file was created.
result.RECOVERED: The incomplete transaction was rolled back to its prior state after confirmation. History and alternatives were retained.

errors.REQUEST_REJECTED: The version operation could not finish. Check the connection or reload; do not repeatedly submit without a receipt.
errors.VERSIONS_LIMIT: The chapter reached its version count or data size limit. Reduce individual texts or manage other chapters; archived versions still count.
errors.VERSIONS_TEXT_LIMIT: This version exceeds the existing 2 MiB editor limit. Reduce its size.
errors.VERSIONS_TEXT_INVALID: The text contains NUL or unsupported bare carriage returns. Review it before saving.
errors.VERSIONS_CORRUPT: Version records failed structural or integrity checks. No manuscript was overwritten; review history or backups.
errors.VERSIONS_SCOPE: Choose a chapter manuscript inside this project. Open anthology entries as their own projects.
errors.VERSIONS_NOT_FOUND: This version or record is unavailable. Reload the list.
errors.VERSIONS_REQUEST_REUSED: This operation ID belongs to different input. Reload and start a new operation.
errors.VERSIONS_CHANGED: The manuscript or version metadata changed. Stale input was not applied. Preserve your edits and reload for comparison.
errors.VERSIONS_EDIT_MAIN_IN_EDITOR: Use the original editor to change main text. Alternatives cannot bypass save protection.
errors.VERSIONS_ARCHIVED: Restore this archived version before editing.
errors.VERSIONS_MAIN_ARCHIVE: The current main manuscript cannot be archived. Confirm another alternative first.
errors.VERSIONS_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: Recovery could not finish and later file changes were detected. External edits were not overwritten. Review switch receipts and PRE_VERSION_SWITCH history before retrying.
errors.VERSIONS_ALREADY_MAIN: This is already the main manuscript; no switch is needed.
errors.VERSIONS_MIXED: The original has mixed line endings. Resolve them through the existing editing workflow; switching will not convert them silently.
errors.VERSIONS_PROTECTED: Final, committed or superseded main sources cannot be overwritten. Retain a review candidate instead.
errors.VERSIONS_RECEIPT_MISMATCH: The save receipt does not match the expected text. Review revision history.
errors.VERSIONS_UNDO_UNAVAILABLE: This operation is incomplete, already undone or awaiting recovery review. It cannot be undone again.
errors.VERSIONS_UNDO_CHANGED: The text or version metadata changed after the switch. Nothing was undone, to preserve later work.
errors.VERSIONS_RECOVERY_UNAVAILABLE: Safe recovery is unavailable or files changed. Inspect a fresh plan; later work will not be overwritten.

reviewDiffLabel: Read-only candidate snapshot: the main manuscript and alternative as confirmed. Later edits do not change this comparison.
undoReviewConfirm: Withdraw this review-candidate record? Its alternative and history remain retained. It never replaced the main manuscript.
recoveryRequired: An incomplete version transaction was detected. Version writes are paused for this chapter. Viewing, comparison and download remain available. Review switch receipts and PRE_VERSION_SWITCH history first; nothing will resume or overwrite text automatically.
archivedSuccess: Alternative archived; its content is retained.
historyDamaged: {{count}} damaged or unreadable records were skipped individually. Other valid records remain available.
historyTruncated: Showing up to 100 readable switches after inspecting at most 1,000 operation journals. Earlier history remains in the project.
historyDiffLabel: Read-only switch snapshot: the manuscript before the operation and the alternative selected at that time. Interpret it with the record’s applied, undone or interrupted status; it is not the current manuscript.
recoveryTitle: Safe recovery of an incomplete transaction
recoveryDiffLabel: Left: current text on disk. Right: text before this transaction began. This preview makes no changes.
recover: Review and confirm rollback to prior state
recoveryConfirm: Roll back only this incomplete version transaction to its prior manuscript and version metadata. It runs only while current files still match the transaction’s known snapshots and the original main manuscript remains editable. No Canon or State is committed.
recoveryUnsaved: This alternative has unsaved input. Download it first, then explicitly discard and reload before confirming recovery.

recoveryReason.NOT_NEEDED: No incomplete version transaction currently requires recovery.
recoveryReason.KNOWN_STATE: The manuscript, metadata and existing snapshots were verified. Current files still match known transaction states; review the diff before explicitly confirming rollback.
recoveryReason.INCOMPLETE_HISTORY: Historical evidence is missing or failed validation. Recovery scope cannot be established safely. Review existing history or backups; no force-overwrite is available.
recoveryReason.EXTERNAL_CHANGED: The manuscript or version metadata contains later edits outside this transaction. Rollback is disabled to preserve them. Keep your input and review history.
recoveryReason.PROTECTED: The source is now Final, committed or superseded. This panel cannot expand write permissions; use the existing revision review and history workflow.
